title: Offer Grabbing Platform
summary: A secure Laravel API backend for a mobile platform where sellers manage promotional offers and customers browse and grab live deals.
result: High-performance backend for real-time promotional offers
challenge: The mobile platform needed fast and reliable exchange of live offers between sellers and customers.
solution: Built a Laravel API backend supporting seller and customer roles.
Implemented offer creation and management for sellers.
Enabled customers to browse and grab live deals.
Optimized the backend for secure, reliable and scalable data exchange.
outcomes: Delivered seller and customer workflows through a mobile-ready API.
Focused on performance, security and scalability.
